invite_member.en: Pam: You've been invited to Pam, an app for finding help and people near you. Tap to join: {link}
invite_member.es: Pam: Le invitaron a Pam, una app para encontrar ayuda y personas cerca. Toque para entrar: {link}

invite_provider.en: Pam: You have been invited to list your services on Pam. Tap to set up your page: {link}
invite_provider.es: Pam: Le invitaron a publicar sus servicios en Pam. Toque para crear su pagina: {link}

verify_code.en: Pam: Your code is {code}. It works for 10 minutes.
verify_code.es: Pam: Su codigo es {code}. Sirve por 10 minutos.

facilitation_member.en: Pam: {adminFirstName} connected you with a program that can help. Open Pam to say hi: {link}
facilitation_member.es: Pam: {adminFirstName} le conecto con un programa que puede ayudar. Abra Pam para saludar: {link}

facilitation_provider.en: Pam: Someone was introduced to your program. Open Pam to reply: {link}
facilitation_provider.es: Pam: Alguien fue presentado a su programa. Abra Pam para responder: {link}

appointment_24h.en: Pam: You have a visit tomorrow at {time}. {address}. Tap for directions: {link}
appointment_24h.es: Pam: Tiene una visita mañana a las {time}. {address}. Toque para llegar: {link}

appointment_2h.en: Pam: Your visit is at {time} today. {address}. Tap for directions: {link}
appointment_2h.es: Pam: Su visita es hoy a las {time}. {address}. Toque para llegar: {link}

appointment_morning_of.en: Pam: Today at {time} you have a visit. {address}. Tap for directions: {link}
appointment_morning_of.es: Pam: Hoy a las {time} tiene una visita. {address}. Toque para llegar: {link}

attendance_check.en: Pam: Did you make it today? Reply YES or NO.
attendance_check.es: Pam: Pudo ir hoy? Responda YES o NO.

attendance_missed_followup.en: Pam: No problem. We saved a step to set up a new time. Open Pam when you are ready: {link}
attendance_missed_followup.es: Pam: No hay problema. Guardamos un paso para buscar otra fecha. Abra Pam cuando pueda: {link}

staff_request_approved.en: Pam: Your request was approved. Open Pam to get started: {link}
staff_request_approved.es: Pam: Su solicitud fue aprobada. Abra Pam para empezar: {link}

staff_request_denied.en: Pam: Your request was not approved. Questions? Call {supportPhone}.
staff_request_denied.es: Pam: Su solicitud no fue aprobada. Preguntas? Llame al {supportPhone}.

connection_request.en: Pam: Someone on Pam wants to connect. Open Pam to reply: {link}
connection_request.es: Pam: Alguien en Pam quiere conectar. Abra Pam para responder: {link}

saved_place_closed.en: Pam: A place you saved is {reason}. Find others in Pam: {link}
saved_place_closed.es: Pam: Un lugar que guardo {reason}. Vea otros en Pam: {link}

access_limited_notice.en: Pam: Some parts of Pam are turned off for now. Call {supportPhone} with questions.
access_limited_notice.es: Pam: Algunas partes de Pam estan apagadas por ahora. Llame al {supportPhone} si tiene preguntas.

closed.en: closed, so there is no need to go
closed.es: ya no abre, no hace falta ir

not_accepting.en: not taking new people, so there is no need to go
not_accepting.es: no acepta gente nueva, no hace falta ir
